name: Jong Song-ho (정성호)

attribution.legal_posture: Jinmyong Joint Bank representative and coal-export facilitator sanctioned by the United States and Republic of Korea; named by an issuing government or multilateral sanctions-monitoring source; administrative sanctions designation with case-specific charging status and no criminal conviction on record.

caveats: Administrative sanctions listing; the record carries no criminal conviction.
The source supplies its recorded transliterations; an alias transfers to a same-name person or entity only when the source explicitly links it.
Employment aliases may be stolen, borrowed, or synthetic identities; alias ownership and worker identity remain source-unresolved.

Exact-ID merge only: each retained value is explicitly attached by the cited official dataset to the same sanctions-list entry; values stay attached to that entry pending a source bridge to any same-name subject.
SDN.CSV and ALT.CSV are component tables of one OFAC Sanctions List Service dataset/source family; count them as one source family.

The official primary form JONG, Song Ho and alternate romanization CHO'NG, So'ng-ho are retained as source-specific renderings tied to one OFAC entity. Only designation-era Vladivostok city-and-country context is retained; present location and precise address require separate sources. Treasury's coal statements are administrative-source assessments, with no adjudicated finding in this record.

sources.support: Treasury identifies Jong Song Ho as a Russia-based representative of Jinmyong Joint Bank, reports that he had engaged in exporting DPRK coal and, as of 2019, was involved in developing DPRK coal-briquette factories that facilitated coal exports for foreign currency, and records his E.O. 13810 designation. These are administrative-source assessments, not adjudicated findings; no buyer, shipment, factory, account, counterparty, or transaction selector is retained
